title: Who was in the Eureka band
summary: Rene tries to recall Eureka members, such as Verrett on bass and Willie Parker the manager.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Do you remember any of the guys?
Ah, let's see. Who was playing with this band? I was playing with. There was a big bass player. Used to play. I'll be recall his name. Used to stay on Caliope Street. A big brown skin fella.

Yeah. Tall fella. Verrett. Oh yeah. Yeah. He used to play with the real-life band. And, ah, let's see who really played with this guy. Oh, there's another fella too. I can't call him. He used to live uptown. Nice looking fella. Played trumpet. Who was the leader? Who was the manager? Who was the manager?
Who? The manager. The manager? He didn't think of that.
You remember all my Willie Parker when he... Oh yeah. He was the manager. He didn't think of that. He didn't think of that. You remember all my Willie Parker when he...
